newsitem.title: USA: Rite Aid Q4, year sales up.
newsitem.headline: Rite Aid Q4, year sales up.

text.p: Rite Aid Corp said Wednesday its sales for the fourth quarter ended March 1 rose 85.7 percent from a year earlier, to $2.657 billion from $1.431 billion.
The company, which operates the largest chain of retail drugstores in the U.S., said same-store sales for the 13-week quarter increased 10.1 percent.
Same-store sales during the quarter for its Thrifty PayLess unit were up 5.3 percent, it said.
Total sales for the fiscal year ended March 1 increased 28.0 percent, to $6.970 billion from $5.446 billion in fiscal 1996.
Same-stores sales for the year increased 7.9 percent.
The company said complete fourth quarter operating results will be released on March 31.
Rite Aid operates more than 3,500 drugstores in 26 states and the District of Columbia.
